Frequently Asked Questions
Q1: What does ERW mean in scaffolding pipes?
Ans:
 ERW stands for 
Electric Resistance Welded
. This manufacturing process produces strong, uniform welds with excellent dimensional accuracy, making ERW pipes ideal for scaffolding and construction applications.
Q2: Which pipe size is most commonly used?
Ans:
 The most commonly used scaffolding pipe is 
48.3 mm outside diameter (OD)
, which complies with international scaffolding standards and is compatible with Cuplock, Ringlock, and Tube & Coupler scaffolding systems.
Q3: What is the difference between GI and Black Scaffolding Pipes?
Ans:
GI (Galvanized Iron) Scaffolding Pipes
 feature a zinc coating that provides excellent corrosion resistance and a longer service life outdoors. 
Black Scaffolding Pipes
 are self-finish pipes commonly used for indoor applications and short-term construction projects where corrosion protection is less critical.
Q4: Do you supply scaffolding pipes in bulk?
Ans:
 Yes. AMCO Exports supplies 
ERW Scaffolding Pipes
 in bulk quantities for contractors, scaffolding rental companies, infrastructure projects, EPC contractors, distributors, and export customers worldwide.
Q5: Can I get technical specifications or a product PDF?
Ans:
 Yes. We provide complete technical specifications, product catalogs, and PDF datasheets upon request to help customers evaluate the correct scaffolding pipe for their projects.
Q6: What is the standard length of an ERW Scaffolding Pipe?
Ans:
 The standard length is 
6 meters
. We also manufacture custom lengths, wall thicknesses, and finishes according to customer drawings and project requirements.
Q7: What is the difference between an ERW Pipe and a Seamless Pipe?
Ans:
ERW Pipes
 are manufactured using electric resistance welding and are widely preferred for scaffolding because they offer excellent strength, dimensional accuracy, and cost-effective performance. 
Seamless Pipes
 are produced without a welded seam and are generally used in specialized high-pressure or high-temperature applications.
Q8: Which scaffolding systems are compatible with ERW Scaffolding Pipes?
Ans:
 ERW Scaffolding Pipes are compatible with 
Cuplock Scaffolding
, 
Ringlock Scaffolding
, 
H-Frame Scaffolding
, and 
Tube & Coupler Scaffolding Systems
, making them suitable for residential, commercial, industrial, and infrastructure projects.
